confirmation.description: Se consultarán en PuntoSeguro los precios para la edad y el capital que indiques. No se crea ninguna solicitud.
confirmation.title: ¿Consultar precios de seguro de vida por edad?

description: Returns annual life-insurance protection (vida riesgo) premiums available through PuntoSeguro for a resident of Spain, given an age in whole years and a coverage amount, without a date of birth: insurer ids, insurer names and premiums for death, death and disability, double capital, triple capital and death and disability plus 30,000 EUR for serious illnesses. Each premium is the highest that can apply at that age, so with the exact date of birth (list_life_insurance_quotes) the premium is the same or lower; the date of birth is also needed for the application link. Not a whole-market comparison.

age.description: Age of the person to insure, in whole years (18-70)

coverage_amount_eur.description: Requested life-insurance coverage amount in euros

name: get_life_insurance_prices_by_age

annual_critical_illness_premium_eur.description: Annual premium for death and disability plus 30,000 EUR on diagnosis of a serious illness (cancer, heart attack, stroke…); 0 means unavailable

annual_death_and_disability_premium_eur.description: Annual death and absolute permanent disability premium for this age; 0 means unavailable

annual_death_premium_eur.description: Annual death-only premium for this age; 0 means unavailable

annual_double_capital_premium_eur.description: Annual premium with double capital on accidental death; 0 means unavailable

annual_triple_capital_premium_eur.description: Annual premium with triple capital on road-traffic accidental death; 0 means unavailable

title: Get life-insurance prices by age
